sources.title: Amumu Build Guide: [16.10] Challenger NA & EUW In depth Amumu Guide

passive.name: Cursed Touch
passive.text: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.text: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

spells.name: Despair
spells.text: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

spells.name: Tantrum
spells.text: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.text: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

damage.value: Amumu deals sustained magic damage, and his passive adds true damage to magic damage dealt to cursed targets.

archetype.value: Amumu is an AP jungle tank who can mix damage and durability to frontline while threatening carries.

winCondition.value: Amumu wins through teamfights where his crowd control and ultimate can turn a difficult game.

spikes.why: Amumu’s ganks improve when he gains his ultimate.
Amumu’s recommended first recall includes Fated Ashes before the listed core items.

bait.why: Amumu cannot use Bandage Toss’s stun and pull during its three-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Amumu risks falling behind by taking early fights when he is weak and vulnerable to invades.
